summary: Darken the Usage pane's served green tone so its remaining-budget text meets AA contrast in light and dark themes.

replay.detail: Styling only; no production replay changes.

rules.detail: Fixes the measured color-contrast violation; adds no accessibility or scanner exemptions.

compatibility.detail: Served tones are unchanged; green now mixes 50% with the theme ink (#247644 light, #8cddaa dark) instead of 60% green.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; revert the tone mix in apps/fractal-web/src/monitor/UsagePane.tsx and remove this note to recover the prior color.
